arxiv-2302-06591.title: Local retail electricity markets for distribution grid services
arxiv-2302-06591.creator: Vineet Jagadeesan Nair, Anuradha Annaswamy
arxiv-2302-06591.description: Abstract We propose a hierarchical local electricity market (LEM) at the primary and secondary feeder levels in a distribution grid, to optimally coordinate and schedule distributed energy resources (DER) and provide valuable grid services like voltage control. At the primary level, we use a current injection-based model that is valid for both radial and meshed, balanced and unbalanced, multi-phase systems.

arxiv-2308-09185.title: The planar Turán number of { K 4 , C 5 } \{K_{4},C_{5}\} and { K 4 , C 6 } \{K_{4},C_{6}\} Thanks: Amherst College, 220 South Pleasant Street, Amherst, MA 01002 E-mail: ali24@amherst.edu
arxiv-2308-09185.creator: Ervin Győri, Runtian Zhou
arxiv-2308-09185.description: Abstract Let ℋ \mathcal{H} be a set of graphs. The planar Turán number, e ​ x 𝒫 ​ ( n , ℋ ) ex_{\mathcal{P}}(n,\mathcal{H}) , is the maximum number of edges in an n n -vertex planar graph which does not contain any member of ℋ \mathcal{H} as a subgraph.

arxiv-2401-15227.title: Experimental evidence of tonal noise and its control in tip-leakage flows
arxiv-2401-15227.creator: Prateek Jaiswal, Stéphane Moreau
arxiv-2401-15227.description: Abstract The present study is first to provide experimental evidence of tonal noise and acoustic feedback by a stationary airfoil with a tip-gap placed between two side plates. Tones are linked to an aero-acoustic coupling using synchronized measurements between Particle Image Velocimetry and far-field microphone probes.

arxiv-2506-12974.title: First detection of HS 2 in a cold dark cloud
arxiv-2506-12974.creator: G. Esplugues, M. Agúndez, G. Molpeceres, B. Tercero, C. Cabezas, N. Marcelino, R. Fuentetaja, J. Cernicharo
arxiv-2506-12974.description: Abstract We report the first detection of HS 2 towards the cold dark cloud TMC-1. This is the first observation of a chemical species containing more than one sulphur atom in this type of sources. The astronomical observations are part of QUIJOTE, a line survey of TMC-1 in the Q band (31-50 GHz).

arxiv-2512-09847.title: From Detection to Anticipation: Online Understanding of Struggles across Various Tasks and Activities
arxiv-2512-09847.creator: Shijia Feng, Michael Wray, Walterio Mayol - Cuevas
arxiv-2512-09847.description: Abstract Understanding human skill performance is essential for intelligent assistive systems, with struggle recognition offering a natural cue for identifying user difficulties. While prior work focuses on offline struggle classification and localization, real-time applications require models capable of detecting and anticipating struggle online.

pmc-10568302.title: CCLHunter: An efficient toolkit for cancer cell line authentication
pmc-10568302.creator: Congfan Bu, Xinchang Zheng, Jialin Mai, Zhi Nie, Jingyao Zeng, Qiheng Qian, Tianyi Xu, Yanling Sun, Yiming Bao, Jingfa Xiao
pmc-10568302.description: Cancer cell lines are essential in cancer research, yet accurate authentication of these cell lines can be challenging, particularly for consanguineous cell lines with close genetic similarities. We introduce a new Cancer Cell Line Hunter (CCLHunter) method to tackle this challenge.

pmc-10716262.title: Spectroscopy of a mesospheric ghost reveals iron emissions
pmc-10716262.creator: María Passas-Varo, Oscar Van der Velde, Francisco J Gordillo-Vázquez, Juan Carlos Gómez-Martín, Justo Sánchez, Francisco J Pérez-Invernón, Rubén Sánchez-Ramírez, Maya García-Comas, Joan Montanyà
pmc-10716262.description: Mesospheric Green emissions from excited Oxygen in Sprite Tops (ghosts) are infrequent and faint greenish transient luminous events that remain for hundreds of milliseconds on top of certain energetic sprites. The main hypothesis to explain this glow persistence is the long lifetime of excited atomic oxygen at 557.73 nm, a well-known emission line in aurora and airglow.

pmc-11438451.title: Combining Metagenomics, Network Pharmacology and RNA-Seq Strategies to Reveal the Therapeutic Effects and Mechanisms of Qingchang Wenzhong Decoction on Inflammatory Bowel Disease in Mice
pmc-11438451.creator: Yali Yuan, Hairong Hu, Zhongmei Sun, Wenting Wang, Zhibin Wang, Mengyu Zheng, Yunqi Xing, Wenji Zhang, Muyuan Wang, Xinyu Lu, Yitong Li, Chengtao Liang, Zhengdao Lin, Chune Xie, Junxiang Li, Tangyou Mao
pmc-11438451.description: BackgroundInflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a chronic and recurrent inflammatory disease that lacks effective treatments. Qingchang Wenzhong Decoction (QCWZD) is a clinically effective herbal prescription that has been proven to attenuate intestinal inflammation in IBD. However, its molecular mechanism of action has not been clearly elucidated.PurposeWe aimed to probe the mechanism of QCWZD for the treatment of IBD.

pmc-11676932.title: Identification of a Potential PGK1 Inhibitor with the Suppression of Breast Cancer Cells Using Virtual Screening and Molecular Docking
pmc-11676932.creator: Xianghui Chen, Zanwen Zuo, Xianbin Li, Qizhang Li, Lei Zhang
pmc-11676932.description: Background/Objectives: Breast cancer is the second most common malignancy worldwide and poses a significant threat to women’s health. However, the prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets of breast cancer are unclear. A prognostic model can help in identifying biomarkers and targets for breast cancer.

pmc-12384555.title: Biosensor for Bacterial Detection Through Color Change in Culture Medium
pmc-12384555.creator: Aramis A Sánchez, Grettel Riofrío, Darwin Castillo, J P Padilla-Martínez, Vasudevan Lakshminarayanan
pmc-12384555.description: Rapid and accurate bacterial detection is essential in medicine, the food industry, and environmental monitoring. This work presents the development of an optical sensor based on color changes in the culture medium that leverages the optical interaction of bacterial metabolic products.

pmc-12784061.title: Perioperative Outcomes in Simple Cystectomy for Neurogenic Lower Urinary Tract Dysfunction: A Comparison of Surgical Approach, Surgical Teams, and Alvimopan Use
pmc-12784061.creator: Vatsala Mundra, Christina Sze, Samuel Gold, Maude Carmel, Gary Lemack, Ramy Goueli
pmc-12784061.description: PurposeLimited data exist on factors influencing surgical outcomes in simple cystectomy for refractory neurogenic lower urinary tract dysfunction (NLUTD). We evaluated the impact of alvimopan use, surgical approach (robotic vs. open), and single vs. multiple surgeons on peri- and postoperative outcomes.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective study of patients undergoing simple cystectomy for refractory NLUTD.

pmc-13635795.title: Exercise Prescription for Falls Prevention in Older Adults: A Before–After Study of an Online Educational Course for Fitness Instructors
pmc-13635795.creator: Jess M Hennell, Dina Pogrebnoy, Alexandra Gorelik, Romi Haas, Abdi D Osman
pmc-13635795.description: PurposeExercise reduces falls in older adults, yet fitness instructors may lack formal education in prescribing effective fall prevention exercises. This study evaluated the quality of strength and balance exercises prescribed by fitness instructors before and after completing an online course on exercise prescription for falls prevention in older adults.
